expression_parent_rule: parent_expression_inherited names the expression parent. That may be the family parent or a prior room in the same family.
plate_rule: A distinct product job does not require a new plate. NEW_PLATE_WITHIN_FAMILY only when the job, emotional role, or spatial metaphor materially changes.

notes: Arrival repeats the entry still life as the continued doorway. That reason is JUSTIFIED_THRESHOLD_CONTINUATION.
Desk, edit, and quiet are distinct because the metaphor changes. They already exist.
Grandchildren are naming forms. They do not get new plates.
